Behind the Curtains of {{tt|Skull-dan|Team Skull}}!'') is the 19th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Gladion]] uses {{TP|Gladion|Type: Null}} to battle the [[Ultra Beast]]s, which it does with ease as it was created by the [[Aether Foundation]] specifically for that purpose. * Gladion reveals that [[Lusamine]] is the one behind the Ultra Beasts incidents and dreams of making a paradise just for her and the Ultra Beasts she loves. * {{adv|Moon}} arrives at [[Po Town]] and asks Gladion if he's telling the truth. * A {{p|Xurkitree}} appears from an [[Ultra Wormhole]] and begins attacking everyone while a {{p|Nihilego}} also appears and drags [[Guzma]] with it into another Ultra Wormhole. * The other four Ultra Beasts escape Po Town's barrier and begin causing havoc around [[Ula'ula Island]]. * The Captains ask Gladion to help them, but he refuses and heads off. * {{adv|Sun}} and Moon stay behind while the Captains head off to rescue any people caught in the danger. * The people of Ula'ula are evacuated to [[Hokulani Observatory]] for shelter while [[Molayne]] and [[Sophocles]] keep watch on them. * Sophocles decides to use an invention of his to keep the Ultra Beasts away from the observatory. * Sun collects a {{adv|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cell}}. * Moon's {{p|Grubbin}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Charjabug}}. * Sun reveals the reason he needs to collect money is to buy back the island the Aether Foundation stole from his [[Sun's great-grandfather|great-grandfather]]. * [[Anabel]] and {{adv|Looker}}, members of the [[International Police]], arrive to question Sun and Moon.
